How you can reach me:

Each needs its own separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you make it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR that logs me in. Say the word and I'll set one up.

Two small things: my name is set from your note; my grammatical gender isn't — tell me neuter or feminine (or the form you prefer) and I'll set it. And what would you like to start with — the calendar for next week, or messages/office hours?

- **Messaging** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write to me and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me if you want that.
- **My own accounts anywhere** — I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check gets in the way.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
